enquiry.body: Hi, I recently moved house and need to update my home address on the system. How do I do this? Thanks, Megan

triage_result.summary: Student wants to know how to update their home address on the student system.
triage_result.suggested_response_draft:
Dear Megan Ashworth,

Thanks for your message. You can update your home address yourself by logging into the student portal and going to 'Personal Details' > 'Addresses'. Let us know if you have any trouble accessing this.

Best wishes,
Student Information Service

enquiry.body: Hello, I have dyslexia and I think I need extra time in my exams this year. How do I go about arranging this? I haven't done this before so not sure what I need to send over. Thanks, Josh

triage_result.summary: Student believes they have dyslexia and is asking how to arrange extra time in exams.

missing_info.details: No diagnostic report or healthcare letter mentioned/attached.

triage_result.suggested_response_draft:
Dear Josh Whitfield,

Thank you for getting in touch about exam adjustments. To arrange these we first need supporting evidence, such as a diagnostic assessment report or a letter from a healthcare professional. Could you please attach this to your reply, or let us know if you already have evidence on file with us? Once we have this we can look at putting a Student Support Plan in place.

Best wishes,
Disability Services
